title: I Doubled My $10k Trading Account
summary: Creator shares rules learned from backtesting 2000+ strategies; heavy product promotion.

ideas.detail: Require >=100 trades in backtest before trusting results
Reject strategies with backtest max drawdown above 20%
Strategy must beat buy-and-hold benchmark on the same asset/period
Trend-following strategies are easier to trade live than mean-reversion
Avoid multi-timeframe/multi-take-profit strategies; prone to lookahead bias
Always backtest with real fees; overestimate slippage
Run multiple uncorrelated strategies/coins/timeframes so one covers another's drawdown
Build a watcher that disables a strategy showing signs of decay before losses compound

red_flags: Unverified self-reported '$10k doubled in 12 months' claim
Promotes paid community (Skool) and third-party tools (TradingKit/TriggerTrade)
No out-of-sample/walk-forward testing mentioned in the 2-hour AI strategy hunt step
credibility: Personal anecdotes and stated failure-rate stat (80% of backtests fail live) are plausible and useful; the specific ROI claims and tool endorsements are unverifiable and should be treated as marketing.
